Definition: neuter of a derivative of G2433; an expiatory (place or thing), i.e. (concretely) an atoning victim, or (specially) the lid of the Ark (in the Temple):--mercyseat, propitiation.
BiblicalUsage: hilastḗrion means the mercy seat, propitiation. It turns up twice, in Romans and Hebrews.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: hilastḗrion means the mercy seat, propitiation, and I do not stretch it further.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
